Shadowverse and Uma Musume collaboration kicks off soon


Unsurprisingly, Shadowverse will be having a Uma Musume collaboration in the coming week. Pretty much most, if not all, of Cygames associated properties have made their appearances in their card game, so this was a matter of time. (Dragalia Lost when, Nintendo?)   The associated event portal for the Shadowverse and Uma Musume collab can be found here. Much like the ones before them, the girls will be available as paid leader skins, with Special Week representing Dragoncraft and Silence Suzuka representing Forestcraft. The site also indicates other characters making their appearances for the rest of the classes to be revealed on time. Each leader will have card sleeves, flairs, and emblems as well.



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   They will be available with the coming v3.7.0 update on 24 March 2022 PT, which is also when the game’s next card expansion, Edge of Paradise, launches. The other collaborations have usually included event missions for alternate card art, or “Quest” mode that could be puzzles or just fighting against AI played decks for rewards. A new expansion launch also typically comes with more free card packs if you decide to try out the rotation format.
If you’d just like to immerse yourself entirely in a Cygames property ecosystem, go ahead and dip your toes in this.

reference_summary: Permainan mudah alih popular Cygames Shadowverse dan Uma Musume: Pretty Derby mengadakan kerjasama bermula pada 24 Mac 2022 PT. Kerjasama itu akan memperkenalkan kulit pemimpin berbayar untuk watak Minggu Istimewa (Dragoncraft) dan Silence Suzuka (Forestcraft), serta lengan kad, bakat dan lambang. Kerjasama itu akan bertepatan dengan keluaran pengembangan kad baharu Shadowverse, Edge of Paradise. Kerjasama sebelumnya telah menyertakan misi acara untuk seni kad alternatif dan pertempuran mod "Quest" menentang dek AI. Shadowverse ialah permainan kad berasaskan giliran dengan lebih 1 juta pemain setiap hari dan menampilkan lapan kelas watak, mekanik inovatif dan lebih 1500 kad. Uma Musume ialah permainan simulasi perlumbaan di mana pemain membesarkan dan melatih gadis kuda maya.
